summary: Built ApprovalsListPage: the Approver's landing screen listing contracts awaiting their decision (pending, delegated, or tenant-wide for Tenant Admin), matching the stat-strip + 'Pending Your Approval' panel layout in design/IMG-1.png. ApprovalsListTable renders each approval as a row — counterparty/title, contract type, Approval Matrix Step label, formatted Contract Value, a status badge, and a color-banded AI Risk Score — with the whole row linking to /approvals/{id} (ApprovalReviewPage). Added listApprovals() to the shared approvalsService.js (GET /api/v1/approvals only; the detail/actions/delegate/history calls remain owned by ApprovalReviewPage) and a new useApprovalsList hook with loading/error(+retry)/empty/populated states. The empty state renders the exact copy 'No contracts are currently awaiting your approval.' (falling back to the API's emptyMessage when present) and suppresses the 'View all' link and all row fields, per UC6-AF-006. Registered the new /approvals route in App.jsx alongside the existing routes. Verified with lint (clean), 57/57 unit tests passing (3 new in ApprovalsListPage.test.jsx), a production build, and a Playwright screenshot at 1440x900 against a temporary local mock of GET /api/v1/approvals, compared side-by-side with design/IMG-1.png (IMG-2 and IMG-3 are the Approval Review screen, out of this task's scope per TASK.md).

code_files.description: Added listApprovals() calling GET /api/v1/approvals plus the ApprovalListItemResponse/ApprovalListResponse JSDoc typedefs; the existing detail/actions/delegate/history exports (owned by ApprovalReviewPage) are unchanged.
Fetches ApprovalListResponse with loading/error/refetch state, per the module contract's hook signature.

Grid of approval rows (Contract Title, Type, Value, Counterparty, AI Risk Score, Approval Matrix Step) as links to the Approval Review screen; each row's status badge and risk-banded marker/color are derived from aiRiskScore and status.

Route-level PAGE: breadcrumb/header chrome matching the repo's other pages, a 4-stat summary strip, and the 'Pending Your Approval' panel wrapping ApprovalsListTable, with loading/error(+retry)/empty/populated states driven entirely by GET /api/v1/approvals.

Screen-level tests: populated render with title/value/counterparty/risk-score/matrix-step fields, the UC6-AF-006 empty-state message (and that 'View all' and rows are absent), and an error state with a working Retry control.
Added the /approvals route for the new page, alongside the existing routes (no existing route changed).

pr.title: feat(ui-gen): ApprovalsListPage for pending/completed approvals
pr.body: Implements ApprovalsListPage (UC6-AF-006, UC6-BR-016/017/018): the Approvals landing screen listing contracts awaiting the current user's (or their delegate's, or tenant-wide for Tenant Admin) decision, with the exact empty-state copy when nothing is pending. Calls only GET /api/v1/approvals, matching ApprovalListResponse/ApprovalListItemResponse exactly. See blockers for stat-strip metrics that aren't backed by any field in this task's DTOs.

blockers: Inferred, non-DTO UI behavior: the TARGET DESIGN's four stat cards ('Pending your action', 'High at risk', 'Awaiting > 3 days', 'Completed this month') have no backing summary endpoint or fields in ApprovalListResponse/ApprovalListItemResponse — there is no separate approvals-summary endpoint in relevant_endpoints. I computed the two feasible metrics client-side from the fetched items (pending count = items with status PendingApproval; high-risk count = items with aiRiskScore >= 70, the same threshold ApprovalDetailsCard's risk gauge uses) and substituted a 'Total approvals' card (data.totalCount, a real field) for 'Awaiting > 3 days', and approximated 'Completed this month' as the count of items with status Approved in the current response (no createdAt/completedAt date exists on ApprovalListItemResponse, so a true 'this month' window cannot be computed from this DTO). This is a deliberate, named substitution, not a fabricated field.

Inferred, non-DTO UI behavior: the per-row status/risk marker icon (triangle/clock/check) in design/IMG-1.png has no corresponding field in ApprovalListItemResponse. It is derived client-side from the same aiRiskScore bands as the summary stats (>=70 amber triangle, <40 emerald check, otherwise a neutral clock), not from any API-supplied icon or category field.

Row ordering/grouping: the design shows only pending rows under 'Pending Your Approval'; since ApprovalListResponse does not document a status filter query param in this task's endpoint list, I fetch the full list unfiltered and render items with status === 'PendingApproval' when any exist (falling back to all items only if none are pending), rather than inventing a request query parameter not in the contract.

GET /api/v1/approvals/{approvalId}, POST .../actions, GET .../history, and GET/PUT /api/v1/approval-matrix-config, though listed in this task's 'API endpoints you must call' section (shared story IDs with ApprovalReviewPage and ApprovalMatrixConfigPage), are intentionally not called from this page — they belong to those other tasks per the module contract's component-to-endpoint mapping and this task's 'What you own' section.

design/IMG-2.png and design/IMG-3.png referenced by this task's stories depict the Approval Review screen (gradient risk banner, Decision/Delegate panels, Approval History), which is explicitly out of scope per TASK.md ('Other screens' content visible in the context images is NOT yours'); only IMG-1.png was used as the TARGET DESIGN for ApprovalsListPage.
